info.name: Smart Solar Microgrid - Full System API
info.description:
Authoritative full-system collection generated from the current ASP.NET controllers and request contracts.

Run folders in numeric order, preferably by running the complete collection against an isolated test database.

Before running, set adminEmail and the secret adminPassword to an active bootstrapped Backoffice account.

The run creates unique accounts, a station, a slot, and reservations. There are no delete endpoints, so generated records remain in the selected database.

Raw QR transaction tokens are stored only in temporary pm.variables scope during a Collection Runner execution, then explicitly unset. They are never collection/environment variables or console output.

The collection covers all 40 controller routes plus positive lifecycle checks, validation checks, role-denial checks, QR renewal, old-token invalidation, and duplicate-finalization protection.
